# Massive Improvement Brainstorm

> The Awtsmoos renews the light before every vessel and every road before feet can roam; Awtsmoos.com asks how one semantic doorway can stay immense inside while remaining feather-light at home.

## Possibility universe

1. Separate five-verb lifecycle compilation from eager world/Portal composition.
2. Keep `createAwtsmoos()` fully compatible while adding a lightweight lifecycle factory in a separate import graph.
3. Keep one semantic kernel, compiler federation, constraint truth, cache truth, and provenance path.
4. Prevent lifecycle imports from reaching Procedural Portal or transactional world modules.
5. Preserve default Modeling compiler behavior and low-level kernel isolation.
6. Add recursive import-graph regression coverage.
7. Add an application-ready browser contract instead of arbitrary sleeps.
8. Show the ordered fifteen-stage pipeline from `explain()`.
9. Expose native, partial, delegated, and deferred support honestly.
10. Show selected compiler channels, support state, tier, determinism, versions, dependencies, cost, and diagnostics.
11. Surface unresolved constraints as explicit work rather than a generic count.
12. Show cache hit/miss/bypass plus provenance hash and seed.
13. Keep renderer-neutral artifact → SVG adaptation separate from semantic compilation.
14. Add stable query-string scenario links and keyboard navigation.
15. Add focus-visible and mobile overflow evidence.
16. Split demo renderers before any module becomes monolithic.
17. Add static route/import contracts so package-barrel regressions are caught.
18. Compare lightweight/full factory artifact essentials for equivalence.
19. Measure browser resource count and bounded local timings as evidence, not universal guarantees.
20. Preserve exact-file release staging and two-phase deployment.

## North star

One language. One compiler federation. One constraint truth. Two composition costs: a feather-light five-verb lifecycle when that is all a caller needs, and the full expert world/Portal constellation only when requested.
